name: Employment Enhancement Program
provider: Government of Newfoundland and Labrador, Department of Jobs, Growth and Rural Development

summary.quote: The Employment Enhancement program supports employers in the forestry, aquaculture, agriculture, and fishing sectors, who are engaged in value-added secondary processing, by providing funding to create long-term or seasonal jobs and offering a training allowance for new employees.

funding_types.quote: Wage Subsidy: 75% of wages, up to $15/hour, for 10-28 weeks.

cost_share.quote: Wage Subsidy: 75% of wages, up to $15/hour, for 10-28 weeks.

research.notes: Found on JGRD's 'Wage Subsidy Programs' list for employers. Industry: forestry, aquaculture, agriculture and fishing are NAICS sector 11; value-added secondary processing of their products is manufacturing (31-33). Neither sector answer settles it (a farm that doesn't process, or a manufacturer outside those sectors), so the rule leaves out every other sector and makes 11 and 31-33 unclear (gm2 K2, DECISIONS #23); 'value-added secondary processing' is also a check-this-yourself item. Purpose: jobs (hire) and a training allowance (training). The training allowance ('Up to $3,000 for the individual hired') is not a program maximum, so max_amount is null; cost_share is the 75% wage rate. Structure: 'Must be incorporated or a sole proprietor' gives corporation and sole_proprietor, with co-operatives and non-profits unclear. Intake: not stated. The Program Guidelines were not fetched.
